exposure: TP53 gene codon 72 polymorphism (proline/proline, proline/arginine, arginine/arginine genotypes)
cohort: The study included 88 women with endometriosis and 88 healthy control women from Lahore, Pakistan.
finding: The TP53 gene codon 72 proline/proline (pro/pro) genotype was associated with an increased risk of endometriosis, with the risk further increasing with advancing age, especially in the 27-46 age group.
